notes: Recorded 62 bachelor's, 178 master's and 135 doctoral rows from only 4 of the 31 participating universities whose lists could be read: bachelor's {'Shanghai University of Finance and Economics': 12, 'Donghua University': 50}; master's {'Shanghai International Studies University': 43, 'Shanghai Jiao Tong University': 93, 'Donghua University': 42}; doctoral {'Shanghai International Studies University': 23, 'Shanghai Jiao Tong University': 85, 'Donghua University': 27}. The other 27 universities' programme lists were not read, so this is NOT the complete list of programmes the scheme can fund.

The Commission pages publish no programme list and no number of programmes; each university lists its own on its admissions site, and the Study in Shanghai platform's programme search is a script-driven page that was not used.

Shanghai International Studies University: only rows marked with the Shanghai Government Scholarship in its 2026 graduate table; Chinese-taught majors have only Chinese names in the table, so those names are given in Chinese. Its undergraduate programmes were not found.

Shanghai University of Finance and Economics: bachelor programmes only. Its bachelor list names the scholarship for nine Chinese-taught programmes; its undergraduate notice says all majors are covered, so its three other bachelor programme pages (Sinology and China Studies, and English-taught International Economics and Trade and Finance) are included. No Shanghai Government Scholarship notice for its graduate programmes was found, so none are recorded.

Shanghai Jiao Tong University: its 2027 master's and doctoral lists (Chinese-taught and English-taught PDFs) were read by extracting the English major names; each major appears once per language even where several schools offer it. Its undergraduate programmes were not read. The page names the Shanghai Government Scholarship but does not state that every listed programme is open to it.

Donghua University: bachelor's and master's lists are the 2027 ones and the doctoral list is the 2026 one (the 2027 doctoral list was not yet published). The lists are images and were read by eye. The notice covers Chinese-taught bachelor's programmes only, so the two English-taught design bachelor's programmes, which are marked as not open to entrance scholarships, are left out; every master's and doctoral programme on its lists is marked as open to entrance scholarships.
